gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-neco: Loose pen strokes, then a steady hand. Architects Daughter sprawls casually up top, while Neco, a classic serif, keeps its thin parts visibly lighter yet never brittle, which gives the pair a dignified streak under the doodled heading.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and tidy, with a clear channel running into each round letter. Architects Daughter above it has a smooth, wire-like handwritten line, and that loose-versus-tidy gap is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-recia: Doodled charm meets sharp print. Architects Daughter is best at relaxed, one-weight handwriting with a looping g, while Recia, a serif, does its best work in a faint, calligraphic slant you notice only up close.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-spline-san: Scribbled warmth over clean modern lines. Architects Daughter brings the hand-drawn looseness, and Spline Sans, a plain sans, answers with wide-open curves and uniform strokes, so the strongest quality here is friendliness.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-outfit: Architects Daughter looks hand-sketched, with s curves that swing wide open at both ends and diagonals echoing the stems. Outfit, a plain sans, bends its wire-like strokes into tidy shapes.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-plus-jakarta-: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and exact, built from one steady line with curve endings held well apart. Over a longer passage it would feel crisp and a little cool, which sets off the handwritten warmth of Architects Daughter.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-sora: Sora is precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell. Sora, a plain sans, pairs that crispness with the relaxed handwriting of Architects Daughter, and the clash between drawn and measured is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads geometric and unfussy, each glyph a ribbon of constant width with counters that breathe. Architects Daughter is best at loose, graceful handwriting, and the sans does its best work keeping everything else orderly.
gen-gf-arima-fs-rowan: Arima brings an expressive, bold display voice, with moderate thicks and thins and white space leaking in freely. Rowan's friendly, literary openness makes the pair's best quality its warmth.
gen-gf-astloch-fs-paquito: Knotted rope, then a friendly tilt. Astloch is best at dense, twisted-strand display shapes with lowercase crowding the cap line, while Paquito, a serif, does its best work staying confident and approachable with barely any gap below the caps.
